key_claims.claim: Reducing in-person antenatal visits from 8 to 4 (supplemented by 2 telemedicine contacts) is non-inferior for maternal and neonatal outcomes in low-risk women
Among aspirin-treated high-risk women, higher FMF triple-test estimated risk and specific biomarkers independently predict breakthrough preterm preeclampsia
Pericerclage antibiotics and/or tocolytics may reduce preterm birth, though evidence quality varies by cerclage indication
Individual severe-feature criteria in preeclampsia confer differential risk for adverse perinatal outcomes
Women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy show persistent adverse cardiovascular and anthropometric profiles at 12 months postpartum compared with normotensive controls
